core_obligations: The author simulates composed query trees through paired input distributions and the newly defined max-conflict measure, derives a quantitative inner randomized-query lower bound through information accumulation, and supplies a matching relational construction. The lower bound and its optimality example form one counted complexity object. The finite output set, partial-function conventions and exact 1/3 versus 4/9 error parameters are retained; incomparable stronger bounds are not ruled out.
